response.query: Which adaptive-illumination or duty-cycle strategies (sparse Z-stacks, lower laser power, ROI-triggered imaging) will we implement, and how will we quantify bias on protrusion lifetimes and spectral metrics?
response.answer: We will implement sparse Z-stacks, lower laser power, and ROI-triggered imaging. Bias on protrusion lifetimes and spectral metrics will be quantified using statistical analysis of fluorescence intensity and lifetime measurements.
